description_en: Deletes a queue in a cluster
description_zh: 调用DeleteQueue删除一个集群中的队列
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc delete-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name workq --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteQueue

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue that you want to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html operation to query the name of the queue
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的队列名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html获取队列名称
parameters.name: queue_name
